reconcile.note: Gill reads the plural they in Acts 13:27 as Joseph of Arimathea and Nicodemus, two dissenting council members, not the rulers who condemned Jesus.

sides.snippet: taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock
sides.verseText: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

sides.snippet: they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb
sides.verseText: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
